newsitem.title: UK: Xenova Group to raise 22.6 mln stg on listing.
newsitem.headline: Xenova Group to raise 22.6 mln stg on listing.

text.p: British biopharmaceutical group Xenova Group Plc said it would raise 22.6 million stg, before expenses, in an issue of new shares at 215p each.
The company is seeking a listing on the London Stock Exchange and would have a market capitalisation of around 50 million stg.
Xenova speicalises in the discovery and development of drugs from natural sources such as fungi, bacteria and plants.
The company said about 9.59 million shares have been subscribed by institutional investors.
In addition, Zeneca is investing two million stg in Xenova through subscription of 930,000 shares.
The company expects trading in its shares to start from December 19, 1996.
